The 2007-06-01 to 2007-08-31 SST is compared with that threshold, and runs of at least 5 hot days, with gaps of up to 2 days joined, are written to the mask. Smoothing reaches pools from day of year 138 to 259 (May 12 to Sep 20 in each year), and day 60 never reaches the target days."}
